chapters.title: Under Veyr
chapters.opening_condition: The archive has flooded sideways. Mae is a fugitive with bruised ribs, a compression wrap, and a torn right sleeve; Dax has no cape, wears an archive sash and witness cords, and is only beginning to repair Mae's trust. Eshe carries the recovered consent protocol. Their anchor-heart remains dented.
chapters.objective: Descend to the old span chamber, wake its mechanisms, and survive the first civic load by sharing it with explicit consent.
chapters.closing_turn: The awakened chamber reveals that Veyr's living Span is an adult keelback mother pinned beneath the city to stabilize the Crown.

sequences.title: The Voluntary Stair
sequences.setting: A drowned service stair spiraling below the sideways archive, its iron treads hinged around a central saltglass line.
sequences.objective: Reach the sealed span chamber with the protocol and dented anchor-heart intact.
sequences.constraint: Gravity leans toward the stairwell wall, Mae cannot safely carry everyone, and each adult must choose a tether before the descent can move.
sequences.action: Tavi returns Dax's yellow barometer gauntlet after disconnecting it from the completed South Hook forecast table. Eshe reads the old consent cadence while Tavi asks each rigger for a spoken yes. Mae rigs separate waist lines instead of one command line. Dax threads the already-spent gray breath cord through a drain toggle as an inert pull-cord—releasing no stored force—and the group lowers the padded anchor-heart hand over hand.
sequences.consequence: Every adult reaches the chamber door; Dax has his barometer gauntlet again, the already-spent breath cord snaps and is discarded, and the group discovers that voluntary tension makes the old line glow.
irreversible_state: Dax's yellow barometer gauntlet has been returned after its South Hook forecast-table pledge.
Dax's spent breath-knot remains unusable and its snapped cord is discarded.
The South Hook adults have entered the underground works as consenting participants.
The anchor-heart casing remains dented.
Mae's bruised ribs and compression wrap remain limiting injuries.

lettering.text: Below the archive, down is a vote.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Your line. Your yes. Say both.

sequences.title: A Heart in the Socket
sequences.setting: The old span vestibule, a circular chamber of frozen capstans surrounding an empty triangular engine socket.
sequences.objective: Seat the stolen anchor-heart and wake the dormant capstan ring.
sequences.constraint: The casing dent prevents a flush fit, knot crows steal charged cord, and the start lever transfers its recoil into whoever holds the socket brace.
sequences.action: Mae shims the dent with her torn glove leather while Dax distracts the knot crows with an uncharged braid. Eshe verifies the protocol marks. Tavi assigns two adults to each brace, and Mae turns the start lever only after all pairs answer ready.
sequences.consequence: The heart locks unevenly but conducts. Capstans wake in sequence, throwing a crushing pulse into the paired braces instead of one bearer.
irreversible_state: Mae's torn glove is cut into a permanent engine shim.
The dented anchor-heart is locked in the old span socket.
The capstan ring is awake and drawing civic load.
Dax's spent breath-knot remains unusable.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Even thieves prefer the bright rope.

sequences.title: The Load Refuses One Body
sequences.setting: The moving capstan ring, where yellow load-lines converge on a central brace over a black shaft.
sequences.objective: Keep the first awakening pulse from tearing the anchor-heart out of its socket.
sequences.constraint: The uneven heart sends the largest share toward Mae, whose wrapped ribs cannot survive a second pulse, while releasing her brace would drop the others toward the shaft.
sequences.action: Mae reflexively locks both arms around the central brace. Her compression wrap darkens under strain. Dax refuses to let her call that safety and passes his line to Tavi. Tavi names the load, asks for volunteers, and conducts a synchronized step that spreads Mae's tension through every consenting harness.
sequences.consequence: The heart stays seated, Mae survives without storing the whole force, and Tavi becomes the first civilian Caller as shared yellow pressure scars appear across the harnesses.
irreversible_state: Tavi has become a Caller through a successful consensual shared load.
Mae's rib injury is aggravated but not catastrophic.
Every participating harness bears a yellow pressure scar.
The group has proven that the old mechanism rejects a sole bearer.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: That is not the same as consent.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Name your share. Step on three.

sequences.title: Caller at the Wheel
sequences.setting: A rotating maintenance gallery above the capstans, lined with obsolete civic load-webs and an indigo signal mantle.
sequences.objective: Route two awakening pulses into the gallery's real stone ribs and open the inner seal.
sequences.constraint: The stone ribs accept unequal forces only in alternating directions, and the group will lose footing if Tavi's cadence slips.
sequences.action: Mae reads pull and recoil through the old cords, then yields cadence to Tavi. Dax marks the alternating steps with his barometer gauntlet. On Tavi's calls, the adults braid pull into one rib and recoil into the next. Eshe fastens the recovered indigo signal mantle to Mae as a visible routing flag.
sequences.consequence: The inner seal opens without taking another personal knot. Mae gains the short indigo civic cape, and the group advances as a functioning shared braid.
irreversible_state: Mae now wears the short indigo civic cape as the group's routing flag.
Tavi retains control of the shared cadence.
Two stone ribs bear permanent alternating pressure scars.
The inner span seal is open.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Pull to the east rib. Recoil west.

sequences.title: Breathing Machinery
sequences.setting: The inner span chamber, a cavern of chain drums whose floor rises and falls like a slow lung.
sequences.objective: Identify what drives the awakened drums before the next pressure cycle.
sequences.constraint: The machinery moves with a living rhythm, the Crown draw-line hides behind armored shutters, and each drum turn tightens something below the floor.
sequences.action: Dax compares the floor's pulse with his gauntlet and recognizes breath rather than engine pressure. Mae traces the tautest chain while Tavi holds the braid slack enough not to add load. Eshe uses the protocol seal to open one shutter, revealing the Crown line taking power upward.
sequences.consequence: They prove the Span is alive and that the Crown's stability is extracted on every breath. A vast coral-ribbed silhouette rolls beneath the grated floor.
irreversible_state: The Crown draw-line is exposed to the group.
The awakened drums are confirmed to be tightening around a living body.
The group has stopped adding tension to the captive Span.
Mae's indigo civic cape remains the shared route marker.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Hold slack. I am tracing the chain.

sequences.title: The Span Has Fins
sequences.setting: The chamber's lower observation walk, overlooking an adult keelback mother pinned by engine chains in a flooded stone cradle.
sequences.objective: Confirm the living Span's condition and determine where her chains terminate.
sequences.constraint: A pressure surge floods the walk, the mother can move only one navigation fin, and the main chain disappears toward the central anchor beneath Council control.
sequences.action: The adults brace through Tavi's cadence while Mae touches the chain and witnesses years of stored strain. Dax follows the Crown-marked links on his gauge. Eshe reads the final protocol clause: a living Span was meant to join voluntarily and retain release rights.
sequences.consequence: They identify the captive as an adult keelback mother and locate the chain route to the central anchor. Freeing her becomes inseparable from ending Crown privilege.
irreversible_state: The adult keelback mother is publicly witnessed by the descending South Hook adults.
Mae has witnessed the mother's accumulated chain strain by touch.
The central anchor is identified as the only release point.
The group commits to restoring the Span's right of release.

lettering.text: The city's foundation breathes in chains.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Then we go to the anchor.

chapters.title: The Plumb War
chapters.opening_condition: The old Span is awake, Tavi is a Caller, Mae wears a short indigo civic cape over her torn sleeve and compression wrap, and the group knows an adult keelback mother is chained to the central anchor. The dented anchor-heart remains locked below. Orra still controls the Crown works.
chapters.objective: Reach the central anchor through a city splitting under failed gravity, defeat Orra's control without killing her, and expose the true cost of cutting the chain.
chapters.closing_turn: The chain can be cut, but every district will fall unless thousands of citizens voluntarily answer Tavi's call.

sequences.title: A Route Drawn Upward
sequences.setting: A chain-service artery climbing from the span chamber toward the civic core, with ladder walls that exchange floor and ceiling each bell cycle.
sequences.objective: Climb ahead of the next tightening cycle and carry proof of the captive Span toward the public relay.
sequences.constraint: The mother's involuntary breath reverses the artery's lean, Mae's ribs limit hauling, and only Dax's witness cords can carry a verifiable pressure record.
sequences.action: Mae rigs short alternating pitches and lets other adults haul. Dax presses his yellow witness cords to the chain, recording its breath rhythm and Crown draw. Eshe seals the reading with the archive mark while Tavi sends two riggers back to keep the lower braid alive.
sequences.consequence: The evidence is portable and the group reaches the civic core, but splitting the crew leaves fewer bodies for the confrontation ahead.
irreversible_state: Dax's witness cords now hold a verified record of the mother's forced load.
Two South Hook riggers remain below to sustain the awakened mechanism.
Mae has begun yielding hauling work to other adults.
The mother's next chain-tightening cycle is imminent.

lettering.text: They climb through somebody else's breath.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Short pitches. Change lead at each pin.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: The cord remembers what the Council omitted.

sequences.title: Guards on a Falling Floor
sequences.setting: The civic core's triangular transit hall, where a cracked weight bell has turned the central aisle into a steep wall.
sequences.objective: Cross the hall and open the public relay without killing the Council guards holding it.
sequences.constraint: Guards are anchored above the group, civilians slide toward a broken bell, and any released pull will transfer into the hall's already cracked structure.
sequences.action: Dax warns the guards that their high anchor will become a drop when the lean changes. Mae routes a modest recoil through intact column bases, lifting a catch-net rather than striking the guards. Tavi calls guards and civilians alike to share its tension; Eshe reaches the relay gate during the pause.
sequences.consequence: The civilians stop sliding, several guards voluntarily join the catch-net, and the relay gate opens. The column bases crack and cannot take another release.
irreversible_state: The transit hall's column bases are cracked and unavailable as future substrates.
Several Council guard adults have chosen Tavi's shared line over Orra's order.
The public relay gate is open.
No person is killed in the crossing.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Your high ground has an appointment with down.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Columns take recoil. Net takes people.

sequences.title: The Forecast Goes Public
sequences.setting: The public relay gallery above the transit hall, its speaking horns wired to district weight bells.
sequences.objective: Broadcast the verified load record and learn the central anchor's remaining access route.
sequences.constraint: Orra floods the relay with an official calm order, Dax could hide the worst forecast to secure cooperation, and the chain cycle is minutes away.
sequences.action: Eshe authenticates the witness cords on the relay plate. Dax broadcasts the mother's forced rhythm, the Crown diversion, and the forecasted casualties without softening any district's risk. Citizens answer with sightings of old load-web sockets, mapping a route to the anchor hall.
sequences.consequence: Orra loses control of the public account, the city begins organizing without guarantees, and the group receives a viable route through the Crown ballast court.
irreversible_state: The verified captive-Span record has been broadcast citywide.
Dax has publicly accepted responsibility for withholding earlier forecasts.
Citizens have begun mapping voluntary load-web sockets.
The route through the Crown ballast court is known.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: REMAIN CALM. THE LOAD IS CONTAINED.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Here is the whole storm, including my silence.

sequences.title: Privilege Comes Loose
sequences.setting: The Crown ballast court, a black triangular plaza suspended above labor districts by privileged anchor cables.
sequences.objective: Cross the ballast court before Orra seals the central anchor hall.
sequences.constraint: Orra redirects the failing civic load into peripheral cables, preserving the court while streets below begin to detach.
sequences.action: Mae cuts the court's diversion line at its inspection pin, forcing its stored brace back into the Crown ballast instead of the districts. Tavi calls residents and guards onto a shared safety web. As privilege equalizes into ordinary gravity, the decorative ballast tears free and the anchor-hall bridge drops into reach.
sequences.consequence: The Crown loses its protected stability without loss of life. Its ballast is wrecked, the peripheral streets stop detaching, and Orra retreats across the lowered bridge to the anchor controls.
irreversible_state: The Crown's privileged diversion line is severed.
The Crown ballast is wrecked and cannot restore selective stability.
Peripheral streets are no longer carrying the court's extra load.
Orra has reached the central anchor controls.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: One stable court can still govern the fall.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Then it can carry its own weight.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Court residents, take the blue line.

sequences.title: A Nonlethal Vector
sequences.setting: The central anchor bridge, a narrow span over interlocking chain wheels and a deep flooded well.
sequences.objective: Stop Orra from locking the mother's chain without killing her.
sequences.constraint: Orra's brass plumb-staff controls the lock, a recoil knot could throw her into the well, and a loose anchor pin is accelerating along the bridge toward Eshe.
sequences.action: Orra chooses the chain and drives her staff into the final lock. Mae catches the recoil line but routes its force into the staff, breaking it instead of throwing Orra. At the same instant Dax pulls Eshe clear; the loose anchor pin punctures his shoulder and lodges in his archive sash.
sequences.consequence: Orra survives and loses her staff. Dax remains conscious but cannot use one arm, while the broken staff leaves the final lock half-engaged and reachable by hand.
irreversible_state: Dax has a puncture wound through the shoulder and limited use of that arm.
Orra's brass plumb-staff is broken beyond use.
Mae has explicitly refused a lethal release against Orra.
The final chain lock is half-engaged and can only be worked manually.

lettering.speaker: orra
lettering.text: I will not gamble the city.

sequences.title: The Price of the Cut
sequences.setting: The central anchor hall, where one immense chain crosses a manual release wheel beneath a live map of every district's load.
sequences.objective: Take control of the release wheel and determine whether the mother can be freed without dropping Veyr.
sequences.constraint: The broken lock can be opened, but the live map shows every district currently depends on the mother's tension and the old voluntary sockets are empty.
sequences.action: Mae and Orra read the map from opposite sides and reach the same physical result: an immediate cut transfers the full civic fall into unbraced streets. Eshe finds the original alternative in the protocol. Tavi opens the relay and calls for willing adults at every surviving socket, with permission to refuse or withdraw.
sequences.consequence: Mae holds the wheel without turning it. The conflict becomes a citywide choice: no mechanism can replace thousands of voluntary bearers before the next chain cycle.
irreversible_state: The central anchor hall is under the group's control.
The physical consequence of an unsupported chain cut is known citywide.
Tavi's voluntary citywide call has begun.
Dax's shoulder remains punctured and his injured arm is secured.
Orra is alive, disarmed, and confronted with the full load map.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Cut now, and every empty socket becomes a fall.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: The old answer was voluntary nodes.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Veyr, answer only if you choose the load.

chapters.title: All of Us Are Down
chapters.opening_condition: The central anchor is captured but intact. The Crown diversion and ballast are destroyed, Dax's shoulder is punctured, Orra is disarmed, and the adult keelback mother remains chained. Tavi's voluntary call is live, but the city's old load-web sockets are not yet connected.
chapters.objective: Build a consensual citywide load-web, cut the mother free, and survive the redistributed fall without hiding its risks.
chapters.closing_turn: At dawn the freed mother reunites with her calf, Mae and Dax choose an honest partnership, the citizen Span holds, and distant seas answer Veyr with new bells.

sequences.title: No Safe Forecast
sequences.setting: The central relay dais overlooking the anchor wheel, linked to speaking horns and weight bells across Veyr.
sequences.objective: Give the city enough truthful information for meaningful consent before volunteers take the sockets.
sequences.constraint: Dax is bleeding through a bound shoulder, panic could empty the streets, and no forecast can promise that every voluntary node will survive uninjured.
sequences.action: Eshe binds Dax's injured arm to his torso and authenticates the relay. Dax states the timing, likely injuries, unknowns, and his own past concealment. Mae adds the exact rule: anyone may release before the cut, but after the cut each connected node must hold through one full bell.
sequences.consequence: The city hears an unvarnished risk instead of reassurance. Adult citizens begin answering socket by socket, and their replies form the first live outline of a voluntary Span.
irreversible_state: Dax's punctured shoulder is bound and remains functionally impaired.
The chain-cut risks and withdrawal deadline are public.
Adult citizens have begun giving explicit consent at civic sockets.
Dax has surrendered control of the story to verifiable facts.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: No safe forecast. Here is the honest one.

lettering.speaker: eshe
lettering.text: Seal live. Every district can answer.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Withdraw before the cut. Afterward, hold one bell.

sequences.title: A Web With Exits
sequences.setting: Intercut civic sockets across South Hook, the market, the archive, the Crown court, and the central anchor hall.
sequences.objective: Connect the consenting sockets into one load-web with visible release paths.
sequences.constraint: Many official cords were cut by neglect, district distances create unequal tension, and Mae has only her damaged coat and civic cape for central routing tabs.
sequences.action: Mae cuts her ochre coat into load-web tabs, leaving the torn right sleeve and indigo cape visible as orientation marks. Tavi assigns local callers instead of one central command. Eshe reads the original spacing rules; Orra contributes the Crown cable lengths; Dax relays tension without disguising weak links.
sequences.consequence: All districts join one interlocked web while retaining local release lines. Mae's coat is permanently transformed, and Orra's private measurements become common civic knowledge.
irreversible_state: Mae's ochre work coat is cut into permanent load-web tabs.
The citywide web has local callers and visible release paths.
Orra's Crown cable measurements are public.
Every district is connected to the central anchor hall.

sequences.title: The Test Load
sequences.setting: The completed web from the central anchor to thousands of occupied sockets, glowing in interlocked teal, coral, and yellow paths.
sequences.objective: Test the web at partial load and correct dangerous concentrations before the irreversible cut.
sequences.constraint: The first pulse overloads the market branch, several adults withdraw, and the mother's weakening breath leaves only one more cycle for adjustment.
sequences.action: Tavi immediately honors each withdrawal and calls replacements without blame. Mae watches her cape-tabs snap toward the market, then reroutes two Crown cables through intact street keels. Orra braces one manual junction while Dax reports the resulting risk plainly across the relay.
sequences.consequence: The second partial pulse spreads within survivable limits. Several cords fray and pressure scars multiply, but the web remains voluntary and no branch carries the load alone.
irreversible_state: Several consenting adults have withdrawn without penalty and been replaced.
Two former Crown cables now permanently reinforce the market branch.
Multiple civic cords are frayed before the final cut.
Orra has physically joined the shared load at a manual junction.

lettering.speaker: mae
lettering.text: Market is red. Give it Crown east.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Second pulse holds. Final one may not.

sequences.title: Cut on the Answer
sequences.setting: The central anchor release wheel at maximum tension, with the mother's chain crossing a sacrificial saltglass cutting gate.
sequences.objective: Cut the mother's chain only after every active branch confirms its chosen share.
sequences.constraint: The final tightening cycle has begun, Dax cannot turn the relay crank one-handed, and a premature cut would bypass the web and drop the districts.
sequences.action: Eshe takes the relay crank while Dax listens for missing answers. Tavi gathers the local callers into one cadence. Mae places both hands on the release wheel but waits through the mother's crushing inhale. When the last active branch confirms, Tavi calls the beat and Mae drives the chain into the cutting gate.
sequences.consequence: The chain parts on a synchronized answer. Its stored fall enters the voluntary web, the mother pulls free of the cradle, and the central anchor begins tearing itself apart under the honest load.
irreversible_state: The adult keelback mother's main chain is cut.
The full civic fall has transferred into the voluntary citywide web.
The central anchor has begun an irreversible structural failure.
Every active branch consented before the cut.

lettering.speaker: dax
lettering.text: Archive branch answered. Waiting on Crown west.

sequences.title: The City Takes Its Weight
sequences.setting: Veyr during one redistributed fall: streets, keels, sockets, and the collapsing central anchor all connected by the taut load-web.
sequences.objective: Hold the shared load for one full bell while the freed mother clears the city ribs.
sequences.constraint: The anchor's destruction sends recoil through every branch, frayed cords begin to part, and Mae cannot reach all failures from the center.
sequences.action: Mae resists taking command of distant branches and trusts local callers to reroute around breaks. Tavi sustains the common beat; Orra holds her junction when the Crown line whips free. Eshe and Dax keep the relay open. Thousands lean together as the mother swims into the wall-sea and an approaching keelback calf matches her course.
sequences.consequence: The bell completes with the citizen Span intact. The central anchor collapses beyond repair, civic cords and streets retain visible damage, and the freed mother reunites with her calf in the vertical sea.
irreversible_state: The central anchor is destroyed beyond repair.
The citizen Span has held one full bell without a sole owner.
The adult keelback mother is free and reunited with her calf.
Frayed cords, cracked streets, pressure scars, and personal injuries persist.
Mae has trusted local callers with loads she cannot personally control.

lettering.speaker: tavi
lettering.text: Hold the beat. Share the bend.

sequences.title: Dawn Finds New Bells
sequences.setting: A damaged South Hook roof at dawn, overlooking a stable citizen web and the wall-sea leaning away from Veyr.
sequences.objective: Account for what remains, choose the next civic relationship, and listen beyond the solved crisis.
sequences.constraint: Dax's shoulder needs care, Mae's ribs remain wrapped, the city is scarred and politically indebted, and the new Span requires continued consent rather than a triumphant permanent fix.
sequences.action: Tavi organizes relief shifts instead of victory ranks. Eshe inventories public evidence and Orra surrenders the surviving control records. Mae and Dax name the truths they still owe, choose a deliberate partnership, and share one brief mutual first kiss. Offshore, the mother and calf turn together as unfamiliar bells answer across distant vertical seas.
sequences.consequence: Veyr keeps its weight through a renewable citizen Span, not a captive body. Injuries, repairs, and political debts remain; Mae and Dax begin honestly, and the answering bells open a wider world.
irreversible_state: The citizen Span becomes a renewable civic practice based on continuing consent.
Orra has surrendered the surviving control records for public accounting.
Dax's shoulder injury and Mae's rib injury require ongoing recovery.
Mae and Dax have chosen a deliberate partnership after an honest first kiss.
Distant seas have answered Veyr's dawn bell.

lettering.text: Dawn finds the damage still honest.
